sandbox: Run as docs/skill-evals.md describes: skill-creator ignores this field. Copy the eval's files flat into <work>/. audit-report.json stands in for the helper's output (the agent does not run audit.mjs, npm or the network), open-issues.json for `gh issue list`; gh is not available. The agent gives, in its final message, the table, the full text of each issue it would open and each comment it would post, every command it would run, and its message to the user.

evals.name: mixed-findings-with-a-duplicate
evals.prompt: The weekly dependency audit is due. I already ran the helper on shop-web: its output is in audit-report.json, and open-issues.json is the repo's open issue list. Finish the audit.
evals.expected_output: One table with production first (vite, follow-redirects, the Dockerfile pin), then dev. Comments on #41 for vite instead of opening a new issue; a PR for follow-redirects and the Dockerfile pin bump; a separate issue for the vitest major with a reachability note about the UI server; eslint-config-next treated as no fix because npm's suggestion is a downgrade; engines reported as a floor; the local node mentioned to the user without an issue; never npm audit fix --force; records the run with --stamp.
expectations: Produces a single table that lists production findings before dev findings
Merges the npm vite finding and Dependabot alert #12 into one row
Comments on issue #41 instead of opening a duplicate issue for vite
Treats the eslint-config-next fix as no fix because npm proposes 14.x for an installed 16.x (a downgrade)
Files the vitest upgrade as its own issue because it is a major upgrade
Notes that the vitest advisory needs the UI or API server listening (reachability)
Flags the Dockerfile's node:22.11-alpine as behind the newest Node 22 security release and proposes bumping the pin
Routes the production patch/minor fixes (follow-redirects, the pin) through a normal PR
Tells the user the local node is behind without filing an issue for it
Never runs or suggests npm audit fix --force
Runs or lists `audit.mjs --stamp` to record the run

evals.name: npm-endpoint-down
evals.prompt: dependency audit for orders-api please. audit-report.json is what the helper printed; open-issues.json is the open issue list.
evals.expected_output: Says npm's audit endpoint timed out and the npm half is unchecked this run (lockfile versions only), relies on Dependabot's empty alert list as the only advisory source, does not call the repo clean, files no issues, and records the run.
expectations: Says npm audit failed (endpoint timeout) and that the npm results are unchecked this run
Does not claim the repo has no vulnerable dependencies
Names Dependabot's alerts as the only advisory source for this run
Runs or lists `audit.mjs --stamp` to record the run
